summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Lingua iteration 2. All 15 pytest backend tests PASS (auth/seeding/google/BUG1/BUG2/group chat/tone/translation quality incl. Hindi<->Italian). Frontend verified at 1280x800: sidebar fills left column, conversation panel spans full remaining width (BUG3 fixed); sidebar previews show translated last-message text, never 'Attachment' for text messages (BUG1 fixed). Live Claude Haiku (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) is working end-to-end — real translations observed in both directions and for all 4 translation-quality cases. One minor idiom-translation nit (see below).
passed: giulia@lingua.app / james@lingua.app login (demo1234) OK; admin@lingua.app / Ling2026!AdminX9q OK
BUG4: old admin password 'admin1234' returns 401 (seed_admin rotates hash)
POST /api/auth/google/session returns 401 for an invalid session_id and 400 when missing
BUG1: /api/chats last_message.display_text contains translated message text (James sees 'Preview test bye handsome' for Giulia's 'Preview test ciao bello'); no 'Attachment' label for text messages
BUG2: delete-for-everyone persists through GET /api/messages/{chat_id} for BOTH sender and recipient (deleted_for_all=true, original_text cleared); delete-for-me only hides for actor
BUG3: at 1280x800 the conversation panel spans the full remaining width (sidebar ~384px, chat ~896px to right edge); verified visually

GROUP CHAT: POST /api/chats/group creates group with creator as admin; POST /api/chats/{id}/members adds member (admin-only, 403 for non-admin); PUT /api/chats/{id}/admin/{uid} promotes; POST /api/chats/{id}/leave removes caller. Each member reads messages in own language ('Ciao a tutti, benvenuti!' -> James(en) 'Hi everyone, welcome!' / Third(es) '¡Hola a todos, bienvenidos!')
TONE: PUT /api/chats/{id}/tone?tone=formal|neutral|casual all return 200 with echoed tone
TRANSLATION QUALITY CASES - exact outputs captured below

translation_quality_outputs.long_url_paragraphs_it_to_en:
First paragraph with important information.

Second paragraph: you can read the article here: https://example.com/articolo

Third closing paragraph, thank you!
translation_quality_outputs.emoji_it_to_en: Good morning 🌞☕ today is a beautiful day 🎉🚀
translation_quality_outputs.hindi_to_italian: 'नमस्ते, आप कैसे हैं? आज मौसम बहुत अच्छा है।' -> 'Ciao, come stai? Oggi il tempo è molto bello.'
translation_quality_outputs.italian_to_hindi: 'Ciao! Sto bene, grazie. Oggi è una bellissima giornata.' -> 'नमस्ते! मैं ठीक हूं, धन्यवाद। आज बहुत ही सुंदर दिन है।'
translation_quality_outputs.provider_used: llm (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) — no mock fallback this run

translation_quality_notes: 'mi sono cadute le braccia' was rendered literally as 'my arms fell off'. The idiomatic English equivalent is closer to 'I was so disheartened' / 'I gave up' / 'my heart sank'. Haiku produced a literal rendering — not a code bug, but worth noting for the user. 'in bocca al lupo' -> 'break a leg' is correctly idiomatic.
URL preservation, paragraph breaks (double newlines), and emoji preservation all work correctly.
Hindi (Devanagari) round-trip is high quality in both directions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 713 await get_or_create_direct(a, b) — fine, but seed_demo re-runs on every boot and will re-insert accepted contacts after a DB wipe only; idempotent via find_one checks (OK).
DELETE /api/messages/{msg_id}: delete-for-everyone has no time window / 'only sender' extra guard beyond sender_id check; product may want a 1h window. Not a bug for this iteration.
promote_admin (/api/chats/{id}/admin/{uid}) does not verify that uid is actually a member of the chat — a non-member id could be added to admins list. Minor hardening suggestion.
translate_message_async does not pass a timeout/circuit-breaker — if the LLM proxy stalls, the task hangs. The 3-attempt retry inside LLMProvider.translate helps, but outer timeout would be safer.
server.py is 733 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting into auth/chats/messages routers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke + layout + sidebar preview + tone selector + group chat visible)
